crossRefs.note: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who…
who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities, who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”
Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”
Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
Yahweh says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in man, relies on strength of flesh, and whose heart departs from Yahweh.
Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are…
Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
“If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’
If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;
Charge those who are rich in this present world that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty…
Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death.…
A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.
Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich, I have found myself wealth. In all my wealth they won’t find in me any…

translations.web: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”
translations.bsb: “Look at the man who did not make God his refuge, but trusted in the abundance of his wealth and strengthened himself by destruction.”
translations.kjv: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
translations.asv: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength, But trusted in the abundance of his riches, And strengthened himself in his wickedness.
